methodology.data: fresh directory per executable/run; seed + zero-based run index
methodology.mode: exact; ordered IDs must equal oracle (stricter than Recall >= 0.95)
methodology.oracle: all queries; exact sent 6-decimal tokens -> float32 storage -> NumPy float64 squared sums; distance/PK lexsort
methodology.order: baseline,candidate on odd rounds; candidate,baseline on even rounds; never parallel
methodology.query_cache_state: same process immediately after durable inserts; no cold-cache claim
methodology.scope: local development comparison only; not official cgroup E, score or rank
methodology.timing: sum of serial pipe request/response wall times, including client IPC overhead
methodology.windows_cpu: owned child process CPU only, sampled outside timers; no evaluator CPU
methodology.windows_io: GetProcessIoCounters transfer/operation counts include pipes and other I/O; NOT physical disk bytes or official cgroup I/O
methodology.windows_memory: PeakWorkingSetSize and PeakPagefileUsage are process lifetime peaks, not phase deltas or cgroup memory; PeakPagefileUsage is commit charge, not disk I/O
